title: Cape Town is BEAUTIFUL | South Africa Trip 01
description:
1st of the two-part travel diary to my South Africa adventure! We explored the sights and taste of Cape Town, and took a road trip down to Cape of Good Hope.

Highlight for me: the African penguins; too much cuteness in one little package.

Watch Part 2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2UmO_5uHbgs
